agent_credentials_shape.name: agent_credentials_shape
agent_credentials_shape.value:
("agent_credentials"."kind" = 'agent' and "agent_credentials"."agent_name" is not null and "agent_credentials"."prefix" is not null)
				or ("agent_credentials"."kind" = 'shared' and "agent_credentials"."agent_name" is null and "agent_credentials"."user_id" is null)

api_tokens_shape.name: api_tokens_shape
api_tokens_shape.value:
("api_tokens"."kind" = 'personal' and "api_tokens"."user_id" is not null and "api_tokens"."session_id" is null and "api_tokens"."task_id" is null)
				or ("api_tokens"."kind" = 'project' and "api_tokens"."project_id" is not null and "api_tokens"."user_id" is null and "api_tokens"."session_id" is null and "api_tokens"."task_id" is null)
				or ("api_tokens"."kind" = 'session' and "api_tokens"."user_id" is not null and "api_tokens"."project_id" is not null and "api_tokens"."session_id" is not null and "api_tokens"."task_id" is null)
				or ("api_tokens"."kind" = 'task' and "api_tokens"."project_id" is not null and "api_tokens"."task_id" is not null and "api_tokens"."user_id" is null and "api_tokens"."session_id" is null)

sessions_queued_at.name: sessions_queued_at
sessions_queued_at.value: ("sessions"."queued_at" is null and "sessions"."status" <> 'queued') or ("sessions"."queued_at" is not null and "sessions"."status" in ('queued', 'running'))

tasks_unreleased.name: tasks_unreleased
tasks_unreleased.where: "tasks"."lease_expires_at" is not null and "tasks"."released_at" is null

users_can_authenticate.name: users_can_authenticate
users_can_authenticate.value: "users"."password_hash" is not null or "users"."external_identity" is not null
